title: Logo — Atelier Helix monogram
request: Design a logo for 'Atelier Helix', an AI-native design studio. We want a geometric double-helix monogram that still reads at small sizes, flat vector style, one-colour mark in deep blue #1A5FB4, with a warm accent #F5C211 reserved for the wordmark. Give us three directions to compare. Deliver the final mark plus a short style note.
